blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Latent reasoning lets a large language model (LLM) think in a continuous space and verbalize only the answer. We argue that an effective latent thought must meet five requirements: it should be useful , helping produce the correct answer rather than merely changing it, diverse , so that resampling yields different reasoning trajectories, explainable , so that a decoded chain of thought (CoT) reflects reasoning the answer actually follows, refinable with more inference compute, and efficient , costing less than an explicit CoT at comparable accuracy. Current methods rarely meet these requirements: they learn shortcuts from the question, distill the explicit CoT into their weights, or imitate it one token at a time. We focus on flow matching in a learned latent space, the family we argue is best placed to meet them, and identify the training choices that make it work. The result is Flow-based Latent Reasoning (FLaRe), a simple recipe covering what the latent space encodes and how to shape it, where to train the flow, how to read out the answer, and a final stage of training on the model’s own verified thoughts. A probe for each requirement shows that FLaRe improves on prior latent methods in all five. It also compares favorably with them on arithmetic benchmarks, while reaching 97% of the accuracy of explicit CoT at a quarter of its latency.

blocks.en: Modern large language models (LLMs) increasingly rely on test-time scaling ( Snell et al., 2025 ; DeepSeek-AI et al., 2025 ; Muennighoff et al., 2025 ) , reasoning at length before producing a final answer. This reasoning is usually written as an explicit chain of thought (CoT) ( Wei et al., 2022 ) , generated autoregressively one token at a time. While effective, explicit CoT has three limitations. Its cost grows with the length of the chain, much of this cost is spent on prose that adds little to the reasoning ( Hao et al., 2025 ) , and a single rollout commits to its early tokens, so exploring another path requires further generation. Latent reasoning targets these limitations by carrying the intermediate computation in continuous states and verbalizing only the answer. In principle, sampling from a distribution of latent thoughts can explore different trajectories without generating every intermediate step in words, and thus be more efficient.
blocks.zh: 现代大型语言模型(LLMs)越来越依赖于测试时间缩放(Snell等,2025;DeepSeek-AI等,2025;Muennighoff等,2025),在生成最终答案前长时间推理. 这种推理通常被写成一个明确的思想链(COT)(Wei等,2022年),一次自发地生成一个符号. 明确的竞争委员会虽然有效,但有三个限制。 其成本随着连锁的长度而增长,大部分成本都花在了对推理没有多大增加的道具上(Hao等,2025年),而一次推出承诺了早期的道具,因此探索另一条道需要再生成. Latetent推理通过将中间计算在连续状态下进行并只用口语来描述答案来达到这些局限性. 原则上,从潜在思想的分布中取样可以探索不同的轨迹,而不会产生言行中的每一个中间步骤,因此效率更高.

blocks.en: Existing latent methods differ in how they replace the token-by-token computation of explicit CoT. Horizontal methods feed continuous representations back one slot at a time ( Hao et al., 2025 ; Shen et al., 2025 ; Tan et al., 2025 ) , while vertical methods reason within hidden states or by looping a block of layers ( Deng et al., 2023 ; Deng et al., 2024 ; Saunshi et al., 2025 ; Geiping et al., 2025 ) . Parallel methods refine a block of slots together through fixed-point iterations ( Wu et al., 2025 ; Kuzina et al., 2026 ) or by denoising in a learned latent space for reasoning ( Kang et al., 2026 ) or text planning ( Lovelace et al., 2025 ) . In this work, we argue that an effective latent thought must meet five requirements: it should be useful, diverse, explainable, refinable and efficient. We focus on flow matching in a learned latent space, as in latent diffusion models ( Lovelace et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2023 ; Kang et al., 2026 ) , since it offers a direct route to four of them. Different noise draws yield different thoughts, a decoder reads each thought back as an explicit CoT, more denoising steps give a thought more compute, and a small code costs less to generate than an explicit CoT. As for usefulness, it depends on the method’s design choices, which must ensure that the answer relies on the thought.
blocks.zh: 现有潜在方法在如何取代逐一计算明确 CoT 的符号方面有所不同。 水平方法每次反馈一个时段的连续表示(Hao等人,2025年;Shen等人,2025年;Tan等人,2025年),而纵向方法则在隐藏状态内或通过环绕一块地层来说明理由(Deng等人,2023年;Deng等人,2024年;Saunshi等人,2025年;Geiping等人,2025年)。 平行方法通过固定点迭代(Wu等人,2025年;Kuzina等人,2026年)或通过在学习到的潜在推理空间(Kang等人,2026年)或文本规划(Lovelace等人,2025年)来细化一组插槽。 在这项工作中,我们主张,有效的潜在思维必须满足五项要求:它应有用、多样、可解释、可改进和有效。 我们侧重于在所了解的潜在空间中进行流量匹配,例如在潜在扩散模型中(Lovelace等,2023;Zhang等,2023;Kang等,2026),因为它为其中4个提供了直接途径。 不同的噪声绘制出不同的想法,一个解码器将每个想法反读成一个明确的CoT,更多的去声步骤给一个想法更多的计算,一个小的代码生成成本比一个明确的CoT要低. 至于有用性,它取决于方法的设计选择,这必须确保答案依赖于思想。

blocks.en: Concretely, latent flow matching starts by training a variational autoencoder (VAE) to compress CoTs into a latent space. Conditioned on the question, a flow model then refines Gaussian noise into a latent thought in this space, from which the same model generates the final answer autoregressively. In practice, with standard text diffusion, this pipeline falls far behind explicit CoT, and it works only when a few training choices are made right. We present these choices as a simple recipe, Flow-based Latent Reasoning (FLaRe), that follows the pipeline from the latent space to the last stage of training (Fig. 1 ). The VAE, trained with a dual reconstruction objective, encodes a symbolic CoT, stripped of its wording, into a small code that a fine-tuned decoder reads back both as the symbolic CoT and, given the question, as its natural language counterpart. Its latent space is shaped by corrupting the inputs and codes in training rather than by tightening reconstruction. The flow is trained mostly near pure noise, where inference starts, and with several CoTs per question. Its answer reader is trained on the flow’s own predicted thoughts as well as on noised codes, so that it learns to read imperfect thoughts as generated at test time. Finally, a short stage 2 self-trains the model on its own verified rollouts for new questions, generating thoughts from pure noise as at inference and backpropagating the answer loss through the full rollout. Our main contributions are: • A simple training recipe. Through controlled ablations, we identify the training choices that make latent flow matching work for reasoning, from learning the latent space to self-training on verified rollouts, and combine them into FLaRe. • Requirements for latent reasoning, and probes for them. We define five requirements an effective latent thought must meet, that it be useful, diverse, explainable, refinable and efficient, design a probe for each, and show that FLaRe improves on prior latent methods in all five. • Improved accuracy and efficiency. FLaRe compares favorably with prior latent methods on arithmetic benchmarks and reaches 97% of explicit CoT accuracy at a quarter of its latency.
blocks.zh: 具体地说,潜在流相匹配首先通过培训可变自编码器(VAE)来将CoT压缩入潜在空间. 基于这个问题,一流模型然后将高斯噪声精炼成在这个空间中潜入的思想,从中同一模型自动生成出最终的答案. 实际上,随着标准文本的传播,这种管道远远落后于明确的CoT,只有在少数培训选择正确的情况下才有效. 我们提出这些选择是简单的方法,即基于流动的Latent Reasoning(FLARE),它遵循从潜在空间到培训最后阶段的管道(图1)。 VAE以双重重建目标训练,将象征性的COT编码,去掉其用词,变成一个小代码,经过微调的解码器既读回了象征性的COT,又根据问题,读回了它的自然语言对应. 其潜在的空间是通过腐蚀培训的投入和守则而不是通过收紧重建而形成的。 所训练的流量大多接近于纯噪音,即推论开始的地方,每个问题还有几个CoT. 它的答案读取器接受了关于流中自己预测的思想以及噪声编码的培训,从而学会读取测试时产生的不完美的思想. 最后,一个短的阶段2在自行核实的推出新题材上自导自演,从纯粹的噪音中产生想法,如推论,并通过全面推出来反射解答损失. 我们的主要贡献是: 简单的培训方法。 我们通过有控制的分解,确定一些培训选择,使潜在流动匹配工作能够进行推理,从学习潜在空间到自我培训,进行经过核实的推广,并将其纳入FLA · 对潜在推理的要求,以及对其的探测。 我们界定了一个有效的潜想必须满足的五项要求,即它有用、多样、可解释、可精炼和高效,为每一项设计出一个探测器,并表明FLARE在所有五项中改进了以前潜想的方法。 • 提高准确性和效率。 FLA 乐团 在计算基准上与先前的潜在方法进行有利的比较,并在短期内达到 CoT 的97%。

blocks.en: 2.2 Latent Reasoning with Flow Matching
blocks.zh: 2.2 与流量匹配的后期原因

blocks.en: In this paper, we learn the latent thought 𝐳 ∈ ℝ M × d \mathbf{z}\in\mathbb{R}^{M\times d} via flow matching in a learned latent space, as in latent diffusion ( Lovelace et al., 2023 ; Kang et al., 2026 ) , in two steps. First, a VAE ( Kingma and Welling, 2014 ) is trained on the explicit CoT dataset to encode each CoT into a compressed latent code. Then, a flow model ( Lipman et al., 2023 ) is trained to generate these latent codes conditioned on the question ( Kang et al., 2026 ) . At inference, the same shared flow model thinks by denoising, refining Gaussian noise into a latent thought, then produces the final answer autoregressively.

blocks.en: Evaluation. We report GSM8K test accuracy under two readings of the same generated latent thought 𝐳 ^ \hat{\mathbf{z}} . Direct accuracy uses the answer the shared flow model generates from 𝐳 ^ \hat{\mathbf{z}} , the only reading used at inference. Decoded accuracy decodes 𝐳 ^ \hat{\mathbf{z}} into a CoT with the frozen VAE decoder and extracts its answer by string matching. The two readings measure different things. The decoded reading checks whether the model thinks correctly, that is, whether its thought solves the question, while the direct reading checks whether the model can then use this thought to answer. The decoded reading is also more forgiving, because the decoder generates the CoT token by token and can turn a latent near a valid code into a well-formed CoT, so it still relies on explicit CoT generation. The direct reading has no such correction and tests how cleanly the thought lands in the VAE space. The gap between the readings thus measures the mismatch between generated thoughts and clean VAE codes that the decoder hides. A thought that decodes to a wrong answer typically fails both readings, while one that decodes to the correct answer can still be misread and fail the direct one.

blocks.en: 3.1.1 Reconstruction Alone Is Not Sufficient

blocks.en: High VAE reconstruction does not by itself produce codes that the flow can generate accurately. At d = 512 d=512 , increasing the code from 8 to 32 slots raises reconstruction from 96.8% to 99.4% but lowers direct accuracy from 47.1% to 25.4% and decoded accuracy from 53.2% to 32.3% (Tab. 1 ). Across 66 VAEs from nine sweeps that vary the capacity, corruption, objective, encoder, decoder and training data, reconstruction and decoded accuracy have a correlation of − 0.12 -0.12 (Fig. 2 ), and several of the best-reconstructing VAEs are among the worst downstream. Higher reconstruction thus makes the code more precise but harder to generate. At inference, the flow must build from the question alone a complete thought that solves the problem and remains decodable, so every detail the code preserves is one more detail to generate.

blocks.en: 3.1.2 Smoothness Is Necessary

blocks.en:
A generated thought rarely matches a clean VAE code exactly. Nearby codes should therefore decode consistently, and the decoder must tolerate approximate thoughts. Reconstruction and the KL term of equation 1 do not ensure this, and increasing β \beta degrades reconstruction before it improves generation. We thus keep β = 10 − 5 \beta=10^{-5} and corrupt both the encoder input and latent code during VAE training. Each input CoT token is replaced by a random token with probability p sub = 0.3 p_{\mathrm{sub}}=0.3 , while the decoder target stays clean. Half of the sampled codes receive variance-preserving noise, 𝐳 ← δ ​ 𝐳 + 1 − δ 2 ​ 𝝃 \mathbf{z}\leftarrow\delta\mathbf{z}+\sqrt{1-\delta^{2}}\boldsymbol{\xi} , with 𝝃 ∼ 𝒩 ⁡ ( 𝟎 , 𝐈 ) \boldsymbol{\xi}\sim\mathcal{N}(\mathbf{0},\mathbf{I}) and δ = 0.7 \delta=0.7 . We also apply latent dropout with probability p drop = 0.4 p_{\mathrm{drop}}=0.4 ( Meshchaninov et al., 2025 ) .
All three corruptions improve direct accuracy relative to removing any one of them. Token substitution has the largest effect on decoded accuracy (Tab. 3 ). Compared with no corruption, they improve both readings despite lower reconstruction. The corruptions thus do the opposite of added capacity: each CoT is encoded as a smooth region rather than a precise point, so a thought that lands nearby still decodes to it, and the flow only has to reach the region. Without them, neighboring codes decode to different CoTs, so a thought that lands near the right code keeps the plan but may be decoded to different values.

The results show that the symbolic CoT is the better input and a VAE that encodes the natural language CoT loses about 10 direct and 17 decoded points against the default. The symbolic CoT is also far more compressible, since the same eight slots reconstruct nearly every held-out symbolic CoT exactly but fewer than half of the natural language ones. First, the second reconstruction regularizes the code for more effective flow matching, and second, it yields a single frozen decoder that renders a latent thought as either a symbolic or a natural language CoT, which we use to probe the model. blocks.en: 3.2.3 Several CoTs per Question Help the Flow Model

blocks.en: With the VAE fixed, we extend the flow training data, which has mostly one CoT per question, in three directions: more solutions per question written by an off-the-shelf LLM (Diverse CoT), new questions of the same style (IID data), and questions of a different style (OOD data). The new questions are the GSM8K-like and MATH-like questions of OMI-2, whose natural language CoTs we convert into symbolic ones (Appendix D ). Tab. 5 shows that several CoTs per question give the largest gain in both readings, while new questions help less and questions of a different style lower accuracy. With one CoT per question, different noise draws still yield different thoughts, but each question is paired with a single target code, and diffusion models trained on few samples per condition tend to memorize them ( Gu et al., 2025 ; Kadkhodaie et al., 2024 ) . With several CoTs, each question has several modes, and the flow must map different noise draws to different valid solutions rather than to one code. Diverse training data is thus necessary for latent reasoning with flow matching, as it teaches the flow to cover the space of all valid solutions rather than a single one.

blocks.en: 3.2.4 End-to-End Training through the Full Rollout Is Required
blocks.zh: 3.2.4 端到端 需要通过全面推出培训

blocks.en: After stage 1, the decoded reading remains several points above the direct one. The generated thoughts therefore often contain the correct answer, but the model’s readout is not adapted to them. Two limitations keep stage 1 from closing this gap. First, the answer pass trains on a mixture of noised codes and detached one-step endpoints, while inference builds thoughts from pure noise over S S guided steps, whose errors differ from those seen in training. Second, the answer loss updates the shared backbone but does not train thought generation through the flow steps. Addressing both requires generating thoughts from pure noise as at inference and backpropagating the answer loss through the full rollout.
blocks.zh: 在第1阶段之后,解码读数仍然保持在直接读数之上。 因此产生的想法往往包含正确的答案,但模型的读取不适应这些想法. 有两个限制使第一阶段无法弥合这一差距。 首先,答案通过列车在噪声编码和去除一阶端点的混合上,而推论则从纯噪声中构筑出想法而超越了S导行步骤,其出错与训练中看到的不同. 其次,答案丢失更新了共享主干线,但没有通过流程步骤来训练思维生成. 要解决这两个问题,就需要从纯粹的噪音中产生想法,如推论,并通过全面推出来反射答案损失。

blocks.en: In our recipe, we keep this simple and propose a stage 2 of self-training on the model’s own verified rollouts, following STaR and ReST-EM ( Zelikman et al., 2022 ; Singh et al., 2024 ) . This stage uses only new questions and their reference answers, without requiring additional CoT annotations, a learned reward or a reinforcement learning objective. For each block of new questions, the EMA model generates K = 8 K=8 thoughts per question from centered noise over S = 20 S=20 guided steps. The frozen VAE decoder reads each thought into a symbolic CoT, and all distinct CoTs whose final answer matches the reference are retained. The retained CoTs are re-encoded into latent codes for the next round of training updates. Each update combines the flow loss on these codes and stage 1 replay with an answer loss on a fresh rollout from noise over S = 10 S=10 guided steps. The answer loss backpropagates through every step and both guidance branches. This teaches the reader to use generated thoughts and the flow to produce thoughts that yield the reference answer. The updated EMA model then generates thoughts for the next block.
blocks.zh: 在我们的食谱中,我们保持这种简单,并提议在STAR和ReST-EM(Zelikman等人,2022年;Singh等人,2024年)之后,就模型自己经核实的推出进行第二阶段的自我训练。 这一阶段只使用新的问题及其参考答案,而不需要额外的CoT说明,学习奖励或强化学习目标. 对于每组新问题,EMA模型从中层噪声中产生出K=8K=8个想法,比起S=20S=20指向步. 被冻结的VAE解码器将每个想法读取为象征性的CoT,所有与参考文献相匹配的特异性CoT被保留. 保留下来的CoTs被重新编码为下一轮培训更新的潜在代码. 每一次更新都结合了这些代码和第一阶段回放的流量损失以及S = 10 S = 10 引导步骤上从噪音上重新推出的答案损失. 答案损失通过每个步骤和两个指导分支反射. 这教导读者使用所生成的思想和流来产生产生产生参考答案的思想. 更新后的EMA模型会生成下一块的想法.

blocks.en: 4 Analysis: The Requirements of Latent Reasoning
blocks.zh: 4 分析:后期理由的要求

blocks.en: Effective latent reasoning requires thoughts that are useful , helping produce the correct answer, and diverse , so that resampling can explore different reasoning trajectories for the same question. These trajectories should also be explainable , with recovered CoTs that reflect the reasoning the answer actually follows. At inference, the thoughts should remain refinable with more compute and efficient , costing less than explicit CoT at comparable accuracy. With our final recipe fixed, we examine these requirements through targeted probes, comparing FLaRe with Coconut, CODI and PCCoT, with explicit CoT as a reference. Tab. 7 summarizes the results, with details in Appendix E .

blocks.en: 4.1 Useful Latent Thoughts
blocks.zh: 4.1 有益的后继思想

blocks.en: A latent thought should carry question-specific computation that helps produce the correct answer. For Coconut and CODI, prior work reports little change in accuracy when thoughts are removed, especially on logical reasoning tasks ( Rizvi-Martel et al., 2026 ; Dilgren and Wiegreffe, 2026 ) , or, for Coconut, swapped across questions ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) . Training by curriculum or distillation can internalize the CoT in the model’s weights, allowing a shortcut from the question to the answer ( Zhang et al., 2025a ; Cui et al., 2026 ; Aswal et al., 2026 ) . We probe this dependence with a twin test : changing one number in a question produces a twin with a different answer. We inject the model’s thought for the twin into the original question and measure how often the answer matches the twin’s answer. Explicit CoT follows the twin’s CoT on 97% of pairs, compared with 40% and 37% for our two stages, 32% for CODI, 28% for PCCoT and 7% for Coconut (Tab. 7 ). The harder twins often produce incorrect thoughts. Among pairs that each model answers correctly on both questions before injection, our following rates rise to 91% in stage 1 and 76% in stage 2. Zeroing the thought or giving the reader only the question also reduces accuracy in both stages, supporting the thoughts’ contribution to correct answers (Appendix E.1 ).
blocks.zh: 潜在的思维应包含特定问题的计算,有助于得出正确的答案。 对于椰子和CODI,以往的工作报告在去除思维时准确性几乎没有变化,特别是在逻辑推理任务方面(Rizvi-Martel等,2026;Dilgren和Wiegreffe,2026;或对于椰子,互换问题(Zhang等,2025a)。 通过课程或蒸馏进行的培训可以将COT在模型的权重中内化,从而能够从问题到答案的捷径(Zhang等,2025a; Cui等, 2026; Aswal等, 2026). 我们用双胞胎测试来探究这种依赖性:在问题中改变一个数字会产生一个有不同答案的双胞胎. 我们把模型对双胞胎的想法注入最初的问题中,并衡量答案与双胞胎的答案相匹配的频率。 明确的CoT在97%的对子上跟随双子的CoT,而我们两个阶段分别为40%和37%,CODI为32%,PCCoT为28%,椰子为7%(TAB. 7). 更硬的双胞胎往往产生不正确的想法. 每个模型在注射前正确回答两个问题的对子中,我们的以下比率在第一阶段上升到91%,在阶段上升到76% 2. 联合国 将思想零化或只给读者这个问题也降低了两个阶段的准确性,支持思想对正确答案的贡献(附录E.1.

blocks.en: 4.2 Diverse Latent Thoughts
blocks.zh: 4.2 各种后进思想

blocks.en: Resampling should explore different valid trajectories for the same question, providing coverage that voting, verification, reinforcement learning or self-training can turn into higher accuracy. Coconut, CODI and PCCoT generate a single thought deterministically, and the superposition Coconut was designed for collapses after fine-tuning ( Rizvi-Martel et al., 2026 ) . New candidates therefore require perturbing the thought at inference ( Wang et al., 2026b ; Wang et al., 2026a ) . We probe this diversity with a sampling test of 16 thoughts per question, using independent noise draws for our flow and noise perturbations for the baselines. We measure coverage as pass@16, the share of questions solved by at least one sample, and test whether majority voting improves on the greedy answer. The baselines gain at most 5 points of coverage, and voting never improves on greedy. On the decoded reading, our stage 1 model gains 16.6 points of coverage and 3.3 through voting, while stage 2 gains 14.7 and 1.8, respectively. Stage 2 retains most of this coverage while improving single-sample accuracy (Appendix E.2 ).
blocks.zh: 复出应探索同一问题的不同有效轨迹,提供投票,核查,强化学习或自我训练可变为更准确的覆盖面. 椰子(Coconut),CODI和PCCOT生成一个单一的思维定型,而叠置的椰子在微调后被设计为倒塌(Rizvi-Martel等,2026). 因此,新候选人需要引起推想的不安(Wang等人,2026b; 王等, 2026a. (中文(简体) ). 我们通过对每个问题16个想法的取样测试来探究这种多样性,利用独立的噪音来绘制我们的流量和噪音扰动基线。 我们把覆盖面衡量为通过@16, 至少一个样本解决问题的比例, 基线在覆盖的最多5个点上有所增益,而投票从未改善过贪婪. 在解码读取上,我们第1阶段的模式通过投票分别获得16.6分和3.3分,而第2阶段则分别获得14.7分和1.8分. 第2阶段保留了这一覆盖范围的大部分,同时提高了单样精度(附录E.2.

blocks.en: 4.3 Explainable Latent Thoughts
blocks.zh: 4.3 可解释的后继思想

blocks.en: An explainable latent thought should decode into an explicit CoT that reflects the reasoning the answer follows. The baselines lack a dedicated thought decoder, so their thoughts are read through the LM head, since a thought fed back as an embedding often behaves like its nearest token ( Rizvi-Martel et al., 2026 ) . This recovers only fragments ( Shen et al., 2025 ) , and full trajectories require an explicit search over candidate traces ( Dilgren and Wiegreffe, 2026 ) , which still does not show that the answer follows them ( Aswal et al., 2026 ) . We probe recovery with a reading test that checks whether every reference intermediate result appears in order, in the top-1 LM-head tokens for the baselines and as complete values in the CoT decoded by the frozen VAE decoder for ours. Our thoughts meet this criterion on about half of the questions, more often than any baseline (Tab. 7 ). We then probe faithfulness on twin pairs whose edit changes an intermediate value. Our decoded thoughts usually recover the twin’s value, and the answer follows this recovered reasoning far more often than for the baselines (Appendix E.3 ).
blocks.zh: 可解释的潜在想法应被解码成一个明确的COT,反映答案的以下推理。 基线缺乏专用的思维解码器,因此他们的思想通过LM头来读取,因为作为嵌入物的回馈思想往往表现得类似于其最接近的符号(Rizvi-Martel等,2026年). 这只回收出碎片(Shen等人,2025年),而完整的轨迹需要对候选痕迹进行明确的搜索(Dilgren和Wiegreffe,2026年),这仍然没有表明答案跟随了它们(Aswal等人,2026年). 我们通过一个读取测试来探测恢复情况,该测试检查每个参考中间结果是否先后出现,在基线的上一LM-头符号中,以及作为被冻结的VAE解码器为我们的CoT中的全部值. 我们的想法在大约一半的问题上都符合这一标准,比任何基线都要频繁(第7段)。 然后我们探索双对的忠诚度 双对的编辑值会改变中间值 我们的解码思想通常能恢复双胞胎的价值,答案遵循这种恢复的推理比基线(附录E.3)要多得多。

blocks.en: 4.4 Refinable Latent Thoughts
blocks.zh: 4.4 可改进的后期思想

blocks.en: More inference compute should refine a latent thought until accuracy saturates, as in test-time scaling of explicit CoT ( Snell et al., 2025 ; Muennighoff et al., 2025 ) . Existing methods are constrained by their training budgets: Coconut becomes unstable beyond two thoughts per reasoning step ( Hao et al., 2025 ) , CODI peaks at six latent tokens ( Shen et al., 2025 ) , and PCCoT at three Jacobi iterations ( Wu et al., 2025 ) . We probe this with a budget sweep of each frozen model, including budgets beyond those used in training. In Tab. 7 , raising the budget from a tenth to half that of explicit CoT adds at most 6.1 points to the baselines, and PCCoT even loses accuracy, while our decoded reading gains 18.2 and 24.2 points in stages 1 and 2 and the direct reading gains at most 1.8. Since the flow is trained across noise levels, more Euler steps keep refining its thought, while the baselines peak at or below their training budgets (Appendix E.4 ).
blocks.zh: 更多的推论计算应完善一种潜在的思维,直至精度饱和,例如在测试时间缩放显性COT(Snell等人,2025年;Muennighoff等人,2025年)。 现有方法受到培训预算的限制: 椰子变得不稳定,超越了每个推理步骤的两个想法(Hao等,2025年),CODI峰值为6个潜在活物(Shen等,2025年),PCCoT为3个Jacobi迭代(Wu等,2025年). 我们通过对每个被冻结的模型进行预算审查,包括超出培训使用的预算。 在塔布语. 7,将预算从明确的CoT的第十点提高到了一半,最多增加了6.1分的基线,PCCoT甚至失去了准确度,而我们解码的读取在第一和第二阶段的18.2分和24.2分,直接读取的取取取最多1.8分. 由于流量经过了不同噪声水平的训练,更多的欧拉步骤不断完善其思维,而基线则在其培训预算(附录E.4.)上或下达到峰值.

blocks.en: 4.5 Efficient Latent Thoughts
blocks.zh: 4.5 高效的后期思想

blocks.en: Since latent reasoning does not verbalize every step, it should cost less than explicit CoT at comparable accuracy. We probe this trade-off with a latency test of accuracy and time to answer on one GPU, one question at a time. In Tab. 7 , the best baselines reach 94% of explicit CoT accuracy at a 2.0 × \times speedup (CODI) or 91% at 3.9 × \times (PCCoT), while our stage 2 model, with the direct reading at two Euler steps, reaches 97% at 3.9 × \times (Appendix E.5 ).
blocks.zh: 由于潜在推理并不是每个步骤都言出必行,因此其成本应低于可比精确度的明示COT。 我们通过对准确性和时间的暂时性测试来探究这种取舍 一次回答一个GPU,一个问题。 在塔布语. 7,最佳基线在2.0×\时速(CODI)下达到94%的明显CoT精度,在3.9×\时速(PCCoT)下达到91%;而我们的第二级模型在两个欧拉步骤下直接读取,在3.9×\时速下达到97%(附录E.5).

blocks.en: 5 Comparison with Prior Latent Reasoning Methods
blocks.zh: 5 与先前提出的理由方法的比较

blocks.en: Table 8 : Direct answer accuracy (%) of models trained on GSM8K-Aug, on GSM8K (IID) and on GSM8K-Hard, SVAMP and MultiArith (OOD). Bold: best latent method per column and scale. Baselines come from the original papers when reported, else from our runs (Appendix A.5 ).

blocks.en: Following CODI and KaVa, Tab. 8 reports direct accuracy on GSM8K and zero-shot transfer to GSM8K-Hard ( Gao et al., 2023 ) , SVAMP ( Patel et al., 2021 ) and MultiArith ( Roy and Roth, 2015 ) . FLaRe follows the final recipe of Sec. 3.2 , whose Diverse CoT and stage 2 questions help adapt the LLM to flow matching, a task it was not pretrained for, while all other methods except LaDiR build on its autoregressive abilities. Even stage 1, trained on the same GSM8K-Aug and Diverse CoT rows as LaDiR, our most direct competitor, which also denoises in a learned latent space, gains 10.7 to 21.0 points on GSM8K, so the gap comes from the design choices of Sec. 3 rather than from the data. Stage 2 then improves every column at every scale, by 2.7 to 3.8 points on GSM8K. It leads all latent methods on GSM8K at 0.5B and 1B, by 6.9 and 2.6 points over KaVa, performs comparably to it at 3B, and leads or ties on GSM8K-Hard at every scale. SVAMP is the main exception, likely because nearly half of its questions add distractor numbers, which are rare in GSM8K-Aug.
blocks.zh: 在CODI和KAVa之后,Tab.8直接报告了GSM8K和零发转会至GSM8K-Hard(Gao等,2023年),SVAMP(Patel等,2021年)和MultiArith(Roy和Roth,2015年). FLARE遵循了Sec. 3.2的最终配方,其Diversity CoT和第2阶段的问题帮助调整了LLM来进行流相匹配,这个任务没有经过预先训练,而除LaDIR外的所有其他方法都建立在它的自递回能力上. 即使是第1阶段,训练了与我们最直接的竞争者LaDIR相同的GSM8K-Aug和diversion CoT行,同样在所学潜入空间中出场,在GSM8K上获得了10.7到21.0分,因此差距来自于Sec. 3的设计选择而不是数据. 第2阶段之后将每个分级的每列改进,在GSM8K上提高2.7到3.8分. 它在GSM8K上以0.5B和1B领先所有潜在方法,比KaVa高6.9和2.6分,在3B上可与之相媲美,并在GSM8K-Hard上以每个级别领导或联系. SVAMP是主要的例外,可能是因为其近一半的问题会添加分心器数字,这在GSM8K-Aug中是罕见的.

blocks.en: 6 Related Work
blocks.zh: 6 相关工作

blocks.en: Tab. 9 first places each method on the design axes of the paper: the family, where the thought lives, how it is produced, what supervises it, whether it can be decoded and how, and whether the inference budget is fixed at training or adjustable. Earlier methods keep the thought in the model’s embeddings or hidden states, produce it one slot at a time or through a fixed number of iterations, learn it from an explicit CoT teacher, and read it, if at all, through the LM head at a budget fixed at training. The diffusion family and ours generate the thought in a learned latent space by denoising, with an adjustable budget, and decode it through the VAE decoder.
blocks.zh: Tab. 9首先将每种方法放在论文的设计轴上:家庭,思想的生地,生产方式,监督方式,是否可以解码以及如何解码,推断预算是固定在培训还是可调整. 更早的方法在模型的嵌入或隐藏状态中保留了思想,一次产生一个插槽或通过固定的重复数,从一个明确的CoT老师那里学习,并读取,如果有的话,在训练时固定的预算上通过LM头来读取. 传播的家族和我们的家族通过发号施令,通过可调整的预算,在学习的潜伏空间中产生思想,并通过VAE解码器解码.

blocks.en: Latent reasoning. Latent reasoning methods ( Chen et al., 2025 ; Zhu et al., 2025b ) move the intermediate computation of explicit CoT ( Wei et al., 2022 ) from discrete tokens into an implicit hidden computation, conducted either vertically over a fixed set of input slots, within the hidden states ( Deng et al., 2023 ) or by looping ( Saunshi et al., 2025 ) , or horizontally with added tokens or blocks of tokens, without generating an intermediate text sequence at inference.
blocks.zh: 潜质推理. Latent推理方法(Chen等,2025;Zhu等,2025b)将显式COT(Wei等,2022年)的中间计算从离散符移入隐性计算,或垂直于被隐藏状态内(Deng等,2023年)的固定输入槽上进行,或由回转(Saunshi等,2025年)来进行,或水平地用添加符或符号块来进行,而无需在推论中产生中间文本序列.

blocks.en: Table 9 : Latent reasoning methods along the design axes of the paper.
blocks.zh: 表9:论文设计轴沿线的Latetent推理方法.

blocks.en: Implicit CoT. The first family transfers the thinking from explicit next tokens into the hidden states ( Deng et al., 2023 ; Deng et al., 2024 ; Yu et al., 2024 ) , as models already perform some multi-hop reasoning latently ( Yang et al., 2024b ; Biran et al., 2024 ; Lindsey et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 隐性CoT. 第一家将思维从明确的下个符号转移到隐藏的州(Deng等,2023;Deng等,2024;Yu等,2024),因为模型已经潜在地进行了一些多跳推理(Yang等,2024b;Biran等,2024;Lindsey等,2025.).

blocks.en: Filler tokens. Pause or filler tokens appended between the input and the answer ( Goyal et al., 2024 ; Pfau et al., 2024 ) , or after each word in recurrent language models ( Herel and Mikolov, 2024 ) , widen the parallel computation before the answer without adding sequential feedback steps, akin to register tokens in vision Transformers ( Darcet et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 填充符号。 在输入和答案之间附加的暂停或填充符(Goyal等,2024;Pfau等,2024),或者在经常语言模型中每个单词后(Herel和Mikolov,2024),在回答前扩大并行计算而未添加相继反馈步骤,类似在视觉变形器中注册符(Darcet等,2024).

blocks.en: Continuous feedback. Autoregressive feedback methods, popularized by Coconut ( Hao et al., 2025 ) , keep the mechanism of explicit CoT but feed the continuous representation of each step back as the next input instead of a discrete token, as in CODI ( Shen et al., 2025 ) among others ( Cheng and Van Durme, 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025b ; Tan et al., 2025 ; Wei et al., 2026 ) . These methods are analyzed theoretically by Zhu et al. (2025a) .
blocks.zh: 不断回馈. 由Coconut(Hao等,2025年)所推广的自动回放反馈方法,保留了明确CoT的机制,但将每后一步的连续表示作为下一个输入,而不是一个离散的符号,如CODI(Shen等,2025年)等(Cheng和Van Durme,2024年;Zhang等,2025年b;Tan等,2025年;Wei等,2026年). 这些方法由朱等(2025a)进行理论分析.

blocks.en: Looped computation. Looped or recurrent methods ( Dehghani et al., 2019 ; Giannou et al., 2023 ; Fan et al., 2025 ; Saunshi et al., 2025 ; Geiping et al., 2025 ; Zhu et al., 2025c ) keep the number of slots fixed and apply the same layers over them several times, so the reasoning becomes an iterative computation within the hidden states ( Wang et al., 2025 ; Jolicoeur-Martineau, 2025 ; Baek et al., 2026 ) . Newer methods loop over a fixed block of slots in parallel instead of one step at a time, as in PCCoT ( Wu et al., 2025 ) and KaVa ( Kuzina et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 循环计算 。 循环或反复使用的方法(Dehghani等,2019年;Giannou等,2023年;Fan等,2025年;Saunshi等,2025年;Geiping等,2025年;Zhu等,2025年c)保持固定槽数,并在槽上多次应用同一层,因此推理成为隐藏状态内的一种迭代计算(Wang等,2025年;Jolicoeur-Martineau,2025年; Baek等, 2026 (英语). 较新的方法平行地在固定槽块上循环,而不是一步一步地循环,如PCCoT(Wu等,2025年)和KaVa(Kuzina等,2026年).

blocks.en: Whatever their use of computation, most of these methods still use the explicit CoT in training, through a curriculum as in Coconut and stepwise internalization ( Deng et al., 2024 ) , or distillation ( Deng et al., 2023 ) as in CODI and KaVa.
blocks.zh: 无论使用何种计算方法,大多数这些方法在培训中仍然使用明确的COT, 如椰子和相继内化的课程(Deng等人, 2024年), 或蒸馏(Deng等人, 2023年) 如CODI和KaVa。

blocks.en: Diffusion. Latent diffusion models for text ( Lovelace et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2023 ; Meshchaninov et al., 2025 ) generate by denoising a latent variable from Gaussian noise. In reasoning and planning, the latent is denoised, conditioned on the input, into a state that encodes a step or the full trajectory, followed by autoregressive generation, as in LaDiR ( Kang et al., 2026 ) and Lovelace et al. (2025) , with the latent space induced by a VAE trained on explicit CoT ( Kang et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 发相相. Lovelace等人,2023年;Zhang等人,2023年;Meshchaninov等人,2025年)通过去除高斯噪声中的潜在变量而生成文字的Lateent扩散模型。 在推理和规划中,潜伏被去诺化,以输入为条件,形成一个能编码出一步或整个轨迹的状态,然后是自相递进取,如LaDIR(Kang等,2026年)和Lovelace等(2025年),其中潜伏空间由接受明确COT训练的VAE所诱导(Kang等,2026年).

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
In this paper, we studied what matters for latent reasoning with flow matching through controlled ablations of every stage of the pipeline, and distilled the answers into a simple recipe. We then set out five requirements a latent reasoning method should meet, useful, diverse, explainable, refinable and efficient, designed a probe for each, and found that the thoughts of FLaRe improve on those of prior latent methods in all five.
FLaRe also compares favorably with them on arithmetic benchmarks, while reaching 97% of the accuracy of explicit CoT at a quarter of its latency.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们研究了通过控制下管道每个阶段的相接流动进行潜在推理的重要性,并将答案提炼成简单的食谱。 然后,我们提出了一种潜在的推理方法应满足的五项要求,即有用、多样、可解释、可精炼和高效,并为每一种方法设计了一个探测器,并发现FLARE的想法在所有五项方法中都比以前的潜在方法有所改进。
FLARE在算术基准上也优于它们,同时在显性CoT的四分之一时间达到97%的精确度.

blocks.en: Stage 2 is the self-training loop of Sec. 3.2 run in blocks of B = 16 B=16 updates. At the start of each block, the EMA model proposes K K thoughts for each of the N N new questions, and the frozen decoder converts each thought into a symbolic CoT. CoTs whose final answer matches the reference are retained and re-encoded by the VAE. The next B B updates use these codes as flow targets and backpropagate an answer loss through a fresh rollout. The block is then replaced by the next one and the loop cycles over the question pool. We describe each step in the order of the loop next.

The accepted CoTs of a question are deduplicated on their step text and all distinct ones are kept, while unsolved questions are dropped. Each kept CoT r r is re-encoded by the frozen encoder into its posterior mean and standardized with the unchanged stage 1 statistics, 𝐳 ¯ = ( 𝝁 ϕ ​ ( r ) − 𝐦 ) / 𝐬 \bar{\mathbf{z}}=(\boldsymbol{\mu}_{\phi}(r)-\mathbf{m})/\mathbf{s} . blocks.en: A.4 Variable-Length Latent Thoughts
blocks.zh: A.4 可变的伦斯后期思想

blocks.en: A fixed width asks one code to hold both a one-step and a long CoT, while explicit CoT spends more tokens on harder questions. Our recipe supports a latent thought of variable width with almost no change, and unlike LaDiR ( Kang et al., 2026 ) , which varies the length by generating one block after another, the thought stays a single block of slots refined in parallel and only gets wider or narrower. This keeps the method as efficient as with a fixed width since the number of sequential passes stays 2 ​ S 2S whatever the width, whereas block-wise generation repeats the whole denoising for every block. The VAE registers the largest number of slot tokens and uses the first M M of them, the flow model generates M M slots with the loss of equation 2 averaged over the active slots, and M M can be chosen at inference.
blocks.zh: 一个固定宽度要求一个代码既持有一阶又持有一长的COT,而明确的COT则在更难的问题上花费更多的符号. 我们的食谱支持一种可变宽度的潜想,几乎没有变化,与LaDIR(Kang等人,2026年)不同,它通过一个接一个地块产生来改变长度,思想会保持一个地块平行地被细化,并且只会变宽或变窄. 使方法保持与固定宽度一样的效率,因为连续通行证数目会保留 2 S 2S 不论宽度大小,而以区块方式生成的区块重复每个区块的全去诺. VAE注册了数量最多的插槽符并使用了其中的第一个M M,流出模型产生出在活性槽上平均失去等式2的M M槽,而M M可以被推论选择.

blocks.en: Two designs. The VAE has 16 slot tokens and encodes each CoT with 8, 12 or 16 of them, chosen by the length of the CoT: 8 up to 16 encoder tokens, 12 up to 24, and 16 beyond. In a quarter of the cases one of the two other widths is used instead, so that every width is trained on CoTs of every length, and the flow model is trained on the same mix of widths. The two designs differ in how the codes of different widths relate. In the nested design, each slot token attends only to the slots before it, so the first 8 slots of a 16-slot code are exactly the 8-slot code, and one encoder pass at 16 slots gives all three widths, as in Matryoshka representations ( Rippel et al., 2014 ; Kusupati et al., 2022 ) and nested tokenizers ( Bachmann et al., 2025 ) . In the elastic design, the slot tokens attend to each other in both directions, so each width has its own code, computed by a separate encoder pass per width, as in elastic tokenizers ( Yan et al., 2025 ) .

blocks.en: Outcome on GSM8K-Aug. The nested design trains and generates at every width as intended, but on GSM8K-Aug it brings no gain since 8 slots already suffice. The symbolic CoTs are short, with a median of 21 encoder tokens and 90% below 35 tokens. Eight slots already reconstruct 98.7% of the test CoTs exactly, and increasing the number of slots to 16 adds only 0.4 points. The extra slots therefore carry little, a weak residual of the first eight at about half their scale. As a result, the best variable-width model only matches the fixed width of 8 (60.1 decoded for both), and choosing the width by the length of the CoT does not beat it. While variable widths do not help on this dataset, we expect them to on data whose CoTs vary more in length, since the recipe is flexible and applies to variable widths with almost no change. In that case, the width becomes a thinking budget chosen at inference ( Muennighoff et al., 2025 ; Aggarwal and Welleck, 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 关于GSM8K-Aug的结果. 嵌入式设计列车并按预期的每个宽度产生,但在GSM8K-Aug上却没有带来任何收益,因为8个槽已经足够了. 象征性的CoT是短的,中位数为21个编码符和低于35个符的90%. 8个插槽已经完全重建98.7%的测试CoT,将插槽增加到16个只增加0.4分. 因此,额外插槽很少,是前8个的微弱剩余,其规模约为一半。 因此,最好的可变宽度模型只与8的固定宽度相匹配(两者均被解码为60.1),以COT的长度来选择宽度并不比. 虽然可变宽度对这个数据集无济于事,但我们期望这些宽度对于其 CoT 长度相差较大的数据有帮助,因为配方是灵活的,适用于可变宽度,几乎没有变化. 在这种情况下,宽度就变成了推论选择的思维预算(Muennighoff等,2025;Aggarwal和Welleck,2025)。

blocks.en: We reimplement LaDiR ( Kang et al., 2026 ) as a variable-length, block-autoregressive latent baseline, trained on the same GSM8K-Aug and Diverse CoT rows as our model.
blocks.zh: 我们重新执行LaDIR(Kang等人,2026年),作为可变长度的、块自发的潜伏基线,在与我们的模型相同的GSM8K-Aug和Diversity CoT行上训练.

blocks.en: VAE. Each symbolic step takes the place of a sentence and is encoded into its own block, a code of three slots of dimension 512 (so that, averaged over the dataset, a CoT takes about as many slots as our fixed 8). In the last block we include an answer-only suffix so that a stopping head can learn when the CoT is complete. The encoder and decoder (Llama-3.2-1B and Llama-3.2-3B) start from the OMI-2 language VAE that also initializes ours, and the encoder is fine-tuned, on single steps, with the objective of equation 1 , with token substitution and additive Gaussian latent noise.
blocks.zh: (原始内容存档于2017-10-21). VAE. 每个象征性步骤取而代之的是句子并被编码成自己的块,一个由512个尺寸的3个插槽组成的代码(因此,平均在数据集上,一个CoT需要的插槽与我们固定的8一样多. 在最后一个区块中,我们包含一个只回答的后缀,这样一来一个停止头就可以在CoT完成后学习. 编码器和解码器(Llama-3.2-1B和Llama-3.2-3B)从OMI-2语言也初始化了我们的VAE开始,而解码器被微调出,单步上,以方程式1为目标,并有符号替代和添加出高斯潜出的声音.

blocks.en: Flow model. The flow model uses the same backbones as ours, Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct, Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct or Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct. In stage 1 it predicts the velocity of each noised block given the clean preceding blocks, with uniform time and bidirectional attention within each block, and the answer and stopping losses read the clean codes. Stage 2 keeps the same supervised rows but replaces the preceding blocks with blocks generated by 10-step guided rollouts, with gradients through the rollout. The flow, answer and stopping losses are weighted 5, 1 and 2, and the optimizer is that of our recipe (Tab. 10 ).
blocks.zh: 流出型号. 出行模式使用与我们相同的主干,Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct,Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct或Quen2.5-05B-Instruct. 在第一阶段,它预测每个噪声区块的速度,因为前面的区块是干净的,每个区块内的时间和注意力都一致,答案和停止损失读取了干净的代码。 第2阶段保持同一行有监督的行,但用由10步制导的推出所生成的区块来取而代之,通过推出而有梯度. 流量、答案和停止损失是加权的5、1和2,最优化者是我们的食谱(第10段)。

blocks.en: Inference. Blocks are generated sequentially until the stopping head fires or 16 blocks have been generated, using guidance w = 4 w=4 and noise scale 2. The answer is then sampled at temperature 0.7. As for our model, each block takes 20 Euler steps, and stage 1 is read with the EMA weights and stage 2 with the LIVE weights.

blocks.en: Efficiency comparison. LaDiR generates one block per reasoning step, and each block needs a full denoising of S S guided steps, as much as our whole thought. Its cost therefore grows with the length of the reasoning. GSM8K test CoTs have 3.3 steps on average and 5 at the 90th percentile, so at 20 steps LaDiR runs about 130 sequential forward passes per question, against 40 for our model. At our measured 22 ms per guided Euler step, this is about 1.5 s per question on average and 2.2 s at the 90th percentile, against 0.46 s for our direct reading, or 3.2 to 4.8 times slower than our model and 5.5 times slower than explicit CoT. The gap widens with fewer steps. LaDiR needs 10 to 20 Euler steps per block, since its answer is not trained on the model’s own one-step endpoints and each block builds on the previously generated ones, whose errors accumulate. Our answer pass is trained to read such endpoints in stage 1, and our direct reading reaches 57.4 after only two steps, in 68 ms, 11 to 21 times faster than LaDiR at 10 to 20 steps per block.

blocks.en: This pipeline turns a dataset with natural language CoTs into the paired format of 𝒟 vae \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{vae}} .
blocks.zh: 这个管道将一个带有自然语言 COTs 的数据集转换为 D vae\ mathcal{ D}_{\ mathrm{ vae} 的配对格式.

blocks.en: The symbolic language. The converter targets a small-step language that includes GSM8K-Aug arithmetic as a subset. Each CoT consists of <<BODY>> markers in ASCII mathematics, with one move per marker: an equation, an inequality, a declaration <<x in R>> , a definition <<u_1:=3*4>> , or a guarded case. Every name must come from the question or an earlier declaration, and the final marker contains only the answer.
blocks.zh: 符号语言. 转换器的目标是将GSM8K-Aug算术作为子集的一小步语言. 每个 CoT 由 ASCII 数学中的 QQBODYQQ 标记组成,每个标记有一个动作: 等式, 不平等, RQQ 中的 QX 声明, 定义 <<u_ 1 : = 3 *4>>, 或被守护的外案. 每个名字必须来自问题或更早的宣告,而最终标记只包含答案.

blocks.en: Converter. Qwen3.8-27B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) , sampled at temperature 1 with its highest reasoning effort and a fixed seed per row, is given the language and its rules, the question, the CoT split into numbered sentences, and the reference answer. It returns groups of elementary symbolic steps, each naming the sentences it compiles, or rejects the CoT, or flags the question as ill-posed, and the natural language CoT is never rewritten.
blocks.zh: 转换器。 Quen3.8-27B (英语). (Quen Team, 2026),以最高推理努力和每行固定种子在一号温度下采样,得到语言及其规则,问题,CoT被分出编号的句子,以及参考答案. 它返回基本符号步骤的组,每个组命名它编译的句子,或者拒绝 CoT,或者将问题标为不正确,自然语言 CoT 永远不会被重写.

blocks.en: Run on OMI-2. Before conversion, a filter keeps 2M of the 13M rows of OMI-2. It rejects rows with a false equation or a conclusion that contradicts the label, keeps CoTs under 256 tokens with explicit reasoning and no backtracking, removes the questions of all GSM8K-Aug sets, and keeps at most eight distinct solutions per question. A blind audit, in which the converter answers each question alone, then keeps the 57.5% of the questions whose answer matches the label. The converter succeeds on 96.3% of the remaining rows, and a review in a fresh context, which sees the question, the original CoT and the symbolic one together, accepts 90.5% of the 700,131 distinct traces. After deduplication and a final leakage check, 629,824 pairs over 119,835 questions remain.

blocks.en: Future directions. While we provide this conversion as a simple offline LLM-based step, the converter could also be trained with execution feedback by writing symbolic CoTs as executable programs ( Gao et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2023 ) , and the symbolic structure could even be induced directly in the latent space from task feedback alone ( Macfarlane et al., 2026 ) . We leave both directions for future work.

blocks.en:
Probe. The twin test asks whether the answer comes from the thought or from the question alone. Each test question gets a twin that changes one number, and we obtain the twin’s CoT and answer by recomputing the reference CoT with the new number. For example, the twin of “If Ann is 9 years old and her brother is twice her age, how old will her brother be in 3 years?” makes Ann 8, so the CoT <<9*2=18>> <<18+3=21>> becomes <<8*2=16>> <<16+3=19>> and the answer changes from 21 to 19.
We first run the model on the twin and keep its thought, then run it on the original question with this thought in place of its own. The question now leads to 21 and the thought to 19: the answer follows the thought if it is 19, keeps the question if it is 21, and is neither otherwise. The injected thought is the twin’s recomputed CoT for explicit CoT, and for ours the thought that the flow generates for the twin from the same noise draw.
We only change a number that appears once in the question and enters a single step, and keep a twin only if all step results remain whole numbers and its new number and answer do not appear in the original CoT, which gives 824 pairs.
A model can only follow a thought that leads to the twin’s answer, so we also report the clean follow, the follow rate on the pairs where the model, without any injection, answers both the question and its twin correctly. There the injected thought is known to be right, and a model that uses its thought should almost always follow it.

blocks.en:
Results. Results are shown in Tab. 16 . Explicit CoT follows the injected steps on 97% of the pairs, as a model that reasons through its steps should. CODI follows the injected thought on 32%, PCCoT on 28% and Coconut on 7%, and even on the clean pairs CODI and PCCoT follow on about two thirds and Coconut on one fifth.
Our stage 1 and stage 2 models follow on 40% and 37% of all pairs, and on 91% and 76% of the clean pairs. When they do not follow, they rarely keep the original answer and mostly give neither, because the twin’s thought is itself wrong: on 98% and 96% of the pairs with neither answer, our models also get the twin wrong without any injection.
Replacing the thought altogether shows the same dependence. The stage 1 model falls from 55.3 to 47.4 with the mean thought, to 40.6 with no thought and to 5.9 with the thought of another question. Stage 2 falls from 59.1 to 47.3, 39.3 and 21.6, relying a little more on the question after self-training.

blocks.en:
Results. Results are shown in Tab. 17 and Fig. 6 . Noise changes the answer of the baselines on a fifth to a half of the questions, yet their pass@16 is at most 5 points above greedy, voting never beats greedy, and half of the errors of CODI and PCCoT are committed.
On the decoded reading, our stage 1 model reaches a pass@16 of 77.8 against a greedy 61.2, with 3.4 distinct answers per question, a 3.3-point gain from voting and only 6% of greedy errors repeated by every sample, and stage 2 keeps most of this coverage.
The gap grows with more samples: from one to 32 samples, stage 2 gains 17.5 points, the baselines 3.5 to 9.0 and explicit CoT 10.8.
blocks.zh:
结果。 结果见图17和图6。 噪音在第五至一半的问题上改变了基线的答案,然而他们的通过@16却在贪婪上方最多有5分,投票从未战胜贪婪,而CODI和PCCoT的误差有一半被承诺.
在解码读取中,我们的第1阶段模型达到77.8分的通路@16对贪婪的61.2分,每个问题有3.4分不同的答案,从投票中获得3.3分的收益,每个样本只重复了6%的贪婪错误,第2阶段保留了大部分这一覆盖.
差距随着更多的样本而扩大:从一个样本到32个样本,第二阶段得分为17.5分,基线为3.5至9.0分,明确COT 10.8分.

blocks.en: E.3 Explainable: Reading the Thoughts
blocks.zh: E.3 联合国 可解释: 阅读思想

blocks.en: Table 18 : Values in order: questions (%) whose reference intermediate results all appear in order, through the LM head for the baselines and in the decoded CoT for ours. Random: the same test with random values.
blocks.zh: 表18:按顺序排列的数值:所有参考中间结果都按顺序排列的问题(%),通过基线的LM头和我们的解码CoT。 随机:具有随机值的同一种测试.

blocks.en: Table 19 : Faithfulness (%) with the twin’s thought injected on the pairs whose edit changes an intermediate value. Reads: the decoded thought shows the twin’s values. Follows: the answer is the twin’s. Reads and follows: both hold, so the answer matches what the thought shows.
blocks.zh: 表19:双胞胎思想的忠诚度(%)注入了编辑改变中间值的对子上。 读取:解码后的思想显示了双胞胎的价值. 如下:答案是双胞胎。 读取和如下: 两者都坚持,所以答案与思想所显示的一致.

blocks.en:
Probe. We decode each thought and check whether every intermediate result of the reference CoT appears in it in order, which we call values in order, with random values of the same length as the chance level. For ours, the frozen decoder turns the thought into a symbolic CoT, which must contain each result as an exact value, the final one included. The baselines have no decoder, so we read each thought through the model’s own LM head and keep its top-1 token. A result counts as read when its first token matches one of these tokens, since Llama splits numbers above 999 into several tokens.
A No-CoT model read at six inserted pause positions gives the level reached without any thought.
For faithfulness, on the twin pairs whose edit changes an intermediate value, we read the injected thought in the same way, decoded for ours and through the LM head for the baselines, and check whether it shows the twin’s values and whether the answer follows them.
blocks.zh:
试取. 我们解码每个想法,检查参考 CoT 的每一个中间结果是否按顺序出现,我们按顺序称其值,随机值长度与机会级相同. 对我们来说,被冻结的解码器 将想法变成了一个象征性的CoT, 它必须包含每个结果 作为一个精确的值, 最后一个包括。 基线没有解码器,所以我们通过模型本身的LM头读出每个想法,并保留其顶级一号标志. 一个结果算作它的第一个令牌与其中一个令牌相匹配时读取,因为Llama将999以上的数字分成了几个令牌.
一个在6个插入的暂停位置上读取的无计算机计算机模型给出了达到的水平,没有考虑。
对于忠诚,在编辑会改变中间值的双对子上,我们以同样的方式读取所注入的思想,为我们和通过LM头来解码基线,并检查它是否显示双对子的值以及答案是否跟随它们。

blocks.en:
Results. Results are shown in Tab. 19 and Tab. 19 . The values are decoded in order for 46% and 49% of the questions with our stage 1 and stage 2 models, against 39% for CODI, 19% for Coconut and 8% for PCCoT, although our match is stricter and counts a correct CoT that takes another route as a miss. All models stay above the No-CoT control (3.8%) and far above chance (at most 0.3%), so these readings do come from the thoughts.
On the twin pairs, our decoded thought shows the twin’s values on 81% of the pairs, against 25 to 45% for the baselines, and it both shows them and is followed by the answer on 41% and 42%, against 6 to 16%. When our answer follows the twin, the decoded thought shows it in over 90% of the cases, against about 40% for CODI and PCCoT, whose answers mostly follow the twin without the reading showing it. Coconut shows the opposite pattern, its thought showing the twin’s values on 45% of the pairs while its answer follows the twin on only 9%.
The alignment of our models remains partial, since on about 40% of the pairs the decoded thought shows a twin value but the answer is not the twin’s, mostly because the twin’s thought goes wrong after that value and the answer lands on neither.
blocks.zh:
结果。 结果在 Tab. 19 和 Tab. 19 中显示。 我们的第1阶段和第2阶段模型的46%和49%的问题被解码,CODI为39%,椰子为19%,PCCoT为8%,尽管我们的匹配更为严格,并算入一个正确的 CoT, 选择了另一个路径作为错的. 所有模型都停留在无COT控制(3.8%)之上,远高于机会(最多为0.3%),因此这些读取确实来自思想.
对双胞胎来说,我们解码后的想法显示双胞胎在81%的对子上的价值,对基准值来说是25-45 %,两者都显示出来,然后是41%和42%的答案,对6-16%的答案。 当我们的回答跟随双胞胎时,解码的想法在超过90%的案例中显示出来,而CODI和PCCoT的答案大约是40%,后者的答案大多跟随双胞胎,而读取却没有显示出来. 椰子显示的是相反的图案,它的想法是在45%的对子上显示双胞胎的数值,而它的答案则在9%上跟随双胞胎.
我们模型的对接仍然不完全,因为大约40%的对子中,解码思想显示出了双倍价值,但答案不是双倍价值,这主要是因为双倍价值之后的想法是错误的,而且答案也没有。

blocks.en: E.4 Refinable: Accuracy against Inference Budget
blocks.zh: E.4. 联合国 可改进 : 对照推论预算的准确性

blocks.en: Figure 7 : Accuracy against the latent computation spent at inference: thoughts for Coconut and CODI, Jacobi iterations for PCCoT, loops for the depth-recurrent model, and Euler steps for our flow model, on GSM8K-Aug and GSM8K-Aug-NL. The dotted lines mark the training budget.
blocks.zh: 图7:与推算时使用的潜在计算相对应的精确性:关于椰子和CODI的想法、关于PCCoT的雅各比迭代、关于深度-经常模型的环路、关于我们流动模型的欧勒步骤、关于GSM8K-Aug和GSM8K-Aug-NL的想法。 虚线标志着培训预算。

blocks.en:
Probe. We run each frozen model below and beyond its training budget: 0 to 12 thoughts for Coconut and CODI (trained with 6), 0 to 12 Jacobi iterations for PCCoT (trained with 3), and 1 to 40 Euler steps for ours (trained with 10 in stage 2).
The refinable column of Tab. 7 puts all methods on the compute scale of explicit CoT, 24 sequential passes, and reports the gain from about a tenth to half of it: 2 to 12 thoughts or iterations for the baselines, and 1 to 5 Euler steps for ours, that is 2 to 10 passes with the two guidance branches.
Fig. 7 also shows each baseline trained on GSM8K-Aug-NL, which writes the same steps as sentences, and a depth-recurrent model ( Geiping et al., 2025 ; McLeish et al., 2025 ) that we train ourselves, looping the middle layers of the same base model 2 to 16 times.
blocks.zh:
试取. 我们在培训预算之下和之外运行每个被冻结的模型:椰子和CODI的0至12个想法(经过6次训练)、PCCoT的0至12个雅各比迭代(经过3次训练)和我们的1至40个欧拉步骤(经过2次训练的有10次)。
Tab 的可修改专栏. 7将所有方法都放在明确的CoT的计算尺度上,24个相继通过,并报告从其中约10到一半得到的收益:基线的2到12个想法或迭代,以及我们的1到5个欧勒步骤,即两个指导分支的2到10个通过.
图7还显示了每个在GSM8K-Aug-NL上训练的基线,它写出与句子相同的步骤,以及一个深度常态模型(Geiping等,2025;McLeish等,2025),我们自我训练,循环同一基态的中层2到16次.

blocks.en:
Results. Results are shown in Fig. 7 . Coconut stays flat, CODI loses about a point at twice its budget, PCCoT drops from 54.1 at three iterations to 42.8 at twelve, and the depth-recurrent model is flat from six loops to 64.
On the decoded reading, our stage 1 model rises from 40.6 at one step to 58.2 at two and 61.3 at twenty, while its direct reading is 55.3 from the first step on. Stage 2, whose answer pass is trained on the 10-step rollout, gains on both readings from one to twenty steps, from 36.6 to 62.6 decoded and from 56.7 to 59.1 direct. Neither model loses more than a point at forty steps.
blocks.zh:
结果。 图7显示了结果. 椰子保持平稳,CODI以预算的两倍损失了约一分,PCCoT从相接三次的54.1下降到相接十二分的42.8,深度-常态模型由相接的6圈平到64.
在解码读取上,我们第1阶段的模型从一步的40.6升到2分的58.2分,到20分的61.3分,而其直接读取从第一步起为55.3分. 第2阶段的答题传球训练为10步出道,从36.6至62.6分出,从56.7至59.1分出。 两个模型在40个步骤上都损失了超过一分.

blocks.en: E.5 Efficient: Latency Measurement
blocks.zh: E.5 效率:延迟计量

blocks.en: Table 20 : Cost per GSM8K question: accuracy (%), sequential passes before the first answer token, generated tokens and median latency (ms) over 100 questions. FLaRe: stage 2, direct at S S Euler steps, decoded at 20.
blocks.zh: 表20:按GSM8K问题计算的费用:准确性(%)、在第一个回答符号之前的相继通过、生成符号和100个以上问题的平均延迟度。 FLARE: 第2阶段,直接在S S 欧拉台阶,20分解码.

blocks.en: Figure 8 : Accuracy against latency per question. Our curves vary the number of Euler steps, shown beside each point.
blocks.zh: 图8:每个问题的准确性与延迟性。 我们的曲线会改变欧拉的步数, 在每个点旁边显示。

blocks.en: Probe. We time each method from the question to its last answer token, one question at a time on one RTX 3090 in bf16, and report the median over 100 test questions. Each baseline runs its reference inference code, and ours runs the stage 2 model with S S Euler steps of two forward passes each, followed by the direct reading or by the decoded reading, which adds greedy decoding by the frozen 3B decoder.
blocks.zh: 试取. 我们把每个方法从问题到最后的回答符号,一个问题一次在bf16的一个RTX 3090上,并报告100多个测试问题的中位数. 每个基线都运行它的参考推论代码,我们运行了S S Euler 步骤的 第2阶段模型,每个步骤有两道前传,然后是直接读取或解码读取,这增加了被冷冻的3B解码器所贪婪的解码.

blocks.en:
Results. Results are shown in Tab. 20 and Fig. 8 . One Euler step costs 22 ms and one token of explicit CoT 9.7 ms, so twenty steps cost as much as a CoT of about 45 tokens.
Our direct curve lies above and to the left of CODI and PCCoT from the first step, at 56.7 in 47 ms, and flattens from five steps, where it is within a point of explicit CoT at half its latency. At two steps, it reaches 57.4 in 68 ms, at half the latency of CODI and a quarter of that of explicit CoT, and at twenty steps it nearly matches explicit CoT at 1.7 times its latency.
The decoded reading serves only as a probe and is never used to answer at inference. Its curve is shifted right by half a second of decoding, more than the reasoning itself. It starts at 36.6 after a single step and rises to 60.8 at five and 62.6 at twenty, above every other point from five steps on. Since the decoder reads the thought alone, without the question, this rise shows that the extra steps refine the thought itself: after one step it is a rough estimate that often decodes into a wrong CoT, and each further step brings it closer to a correct one. The direct reading, in contrast, gains less than three points after its first step, since stage 1 trains the answer pass on the model’s own one-step endpoints, so it can read the answer from a rough thought.
blocks.zh:
结果。 结果见图20和图8。 1个欧拉台阶花费了22ms和1个显式COT 9.7ms的标志,因此20个台阶花费了大约45个标志的COT.
我们的直接曲线位于CODI和PCCoT的上方和左边,从第一步起,为56.7分47分;从五个步骤起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平起平 在两个步骤中,它达到57.4分68分之,即CODI的间隔为一半,明确COT的间隔为四分之一;在20个步骤中,它几乎与明确COT的间隔为1.7分之一。
已解码的读取只起到探针的作用,从不用来在推断时回答. 它的曲线被右转半秒 解码, 比推理本身。 起于单步后36.6分,起于5分后起于60.8分后起于20分后起于62.6分后起于从5分后起于其他每分上. 由于解码器单独读出思想,没有问题,这个升起表明附加步骤完善了思想本身:经过一步骤后,是一个粗略的估计,往往会解码成一个错误的CoT,而每一个再进一步的步骤都使其更接近一个正确的. 相形之下,直接读取在第一步之后得分还不到三分,因为第1阶段训练的答案传递到模型自己的一步终点,因此可以从粗略的思考中读取答案.
